items.title: West Ham cruise past Derby
items.description: Two late goals underscored West Ham's second home victory in the space of five days and a 3-0 win over Derby that was less decisive than the scoreline suggests.

items.title: Lankshear scores again in Boro win
items.description: Will Lankshear's seventh goal in as many matches gave Middlesbrough a 1-0 victory against previously-unbeaten QPR.

items.title: Haaland’s scores 300th career goal as Man City edge Coventry
items.description: FREE TO WATCH: Highlights from Manchester City’s match against Coventry in the Premier League.

items.title: Haaland hits new record and Fernandez shines as Man City beat Coventry
items.description: Erling Haaland showed how much he loves playing against newly promoted sides by scoring the winner in a nervy 1-0 victory over Coventry to keep Manchester City's record under Enzo Maresca perfect.

items.title: Le Fee penalty rescues draw for Sunderland at Brentford
items.description: Enzo Le Fee rescued a point for Sunderland after dispatching his late penalty to secure a 1-1 draw at Brentford.

items.title: Leeds made to pay for missed chances as Brighton fight back to draw
items.description: Leeds were made to pay for countless missed chances as Brighton fought back to claim 1-1 draw - and continue the Whites' struggles down at the south coast.

items.title: Shankland injured as Naderi scores Rangers winner against Motherwell
items.description: Substitute Ryan Naderi capitalised upon a defensive mix-up to get the only goal of the game as Rangers beat Motherwell to go second in the Scottish Premiership.

items.title: Hull vs Aston Villa LIVE on Sky!
New season, same flaw - Chelsea title hopes already under scrutiny
items.description: With 11 minutes remaining, Chelsea appeared to be cruising to victory in their WSL opener against Aston Villa. So how did they throw it away?

items.title: Jaissle fumes at 'slapstick' goals as Newcastle rescue Bournemouth draw
items.description: Newcastle United manager Matthias Jaissle shares his "mixed feelings" on their late 2-2 draw against Bournemouth, describing the goals conceded by his side at St. James' Park as "slapstick".

items.title: 'It's not Chelsea's standard' - McCabe on 'frustrating' draw against Aston Villa
items.description: Chelsea' Katie McCabe describes their result against Aston Villa as 'frustrating' but also that there's 'no need to panic' as its still early days for the 2026-27 WSL season.
